contract: within one source object priority code the earlier object-RAM entry wins; the code's relationship to each tile layer is set by OBJ_PRI under the CPS-B layer-control draw order; zero tile-pen masks are inert

change_layer_order_field.note: moving the beaten layer to the front of the draw order must change the composite

change_source_priority_code.note: code 1 is hidden under every tile layer, so the object must leave the visible composite

flip_cps_b_mask_bit.note: the measured masks are zero and the CPS2 render path does not draw front pens, so the split is inert: the model predicts NO change, and any change would falsify it

reverse_same_code_entries.note: the earlier entry wins, so exchanging the pair must move the witness pixel

shift_object_one_fitted_pixel.note: a one-pixel source shift must survive the endpoint-aligned 384-to-352 map at the witness column

saturn_controls_note: the three Saturn-side controls (CMDCOLR priority bits, command order, PRIS/PRIN) are executed against the StreetTest build, not here
